component.name: MainScene
component.script:
sub init() ' Seconds to wait for video playback to start before aborting m.loadTimeoutSeconds = 10 m.contentGrid = m.top.findNode("contentGrid") m.listContainer = m.top.findNode("listContainer") m.video = m.top.findNode("videoPlayer") m.loadWatchdog = m.top.findNode("loadWatchdog") m.errorInputGuard = m.top.findNode("errorInputGuard") m.loadingDialog = createObject("roSGNode", "ProgressDialog") m.loadingDialog.title = "Loading video..." m.errorDialog = createObject("roSGNode", "Dialog") m.errorDialog.title = "Playback Error" m.errorDialog.buttons = [ "OK" ] m.loadingDialogActive = false m.errorDialogActive = false m.errorDialogInputEnabled = false m.playbackAttemptActive = false
' Build and set content node m.contentGrid.content = buildContentList() m.contentGrid.observeField("itemSelected", "onItemSelected")
' Observe video state to exit playback on finish or error m.video.observeField("state", "onVideoState")
' Watchdog timer fires if video never reaches "playing" in time m.loadWatchdog.observeField("fire", "onLoadTimeout") m.errorInputGuard.observeField("fire", "onErrorInputGuardExpired")
' Dialog dismiss returns to list m.loadingDialog.observeField("wasClosed", "onLoadingDialogClosed") m.errorDialog.observeField("buttonSelected", "onErrorDialogButton") m.errorDialog.observeField("wasClosed", "onErrorDialogClosed")
m.contentGrid.setFocus(true) end sub
function buildContentList() as object listContent = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode")
' 1. Positional syntax (Overload-style) addItem(listContent, "Big Buck Bunny av1", "https://test-videos.co.uk/vids/bigbuckbunny/mp4/av1/360/Big_Buck_Bunny_360_10s_1MB.mp4", "mp4", "https://test-videos.co.uk/user/pages/images/big_buck_bunny.jpg", "A comedic short film about a giant rabbit")
' 2. Single Object / Associative Array syntax addItemFromObject(listContent, { title: "Sintel h264", url: "https://test-videos.co.uk/vids/sintel/mp4/av1/360/Sintel_360_10s_1MB.mp4", streamFormat: "mp4", thumbnail: "https://test-videos.co.uk/user/pages/images/sintel.jpg", description: "A girl searches for her lost dragon" })
' 3. Array of Objects syntax addItems(listContent, [ { title: "Tears of Steel webm vp9", url: "https://test-videos.co.uk/vids/bigbuckbunny/webm/vp9/360/Big_Buck_Bunny_360_10s_1MB.webm", streamFormat: "webm", thumbnail: "https://myvideos.com/thumbs/tears.jpg", description: "Sci-fi short by Blender Foundation" }, { title: "Jelly Fish mkv ", url: "https://test-videos.co.uk/vids/jellyfish/mkv/720/Jellyfish_720_10s_1MB.mkv", streamFormat: "mkv", thumbnail: "https://test-videos.co.uk/user/pages/images/jellyfish.jpg", description: "Sci-fi short by Blender Foundation" }, { title: "Local News Clip mkv.h264", url: "https://test-videos.co.uk/vids/bigbuckbunny/mkv/360/Big_Buck_Bunny_360_10s_1MB.mkv", streamFormat: "mp4", thumbnail: "https://myvideos.com/thumbs/news.jpg", description: "Evening news broadcast" } ])
' 4. Raw JSON String syntax (if loading from API or string) jsonSample = "[{""title"": ""Documentary"", ""url"": ""https://myvideos.com/doc.mkv"", ""streamFormat"": ""mkv"", ""thumbnail"": """", ""description"": ""Nature documentary""}]" addItems(listContent, jsonSample)
return listContent end function
' ===== Positional addItem Parameter Support ===== sub addItem(parent as object, title as string, url as string, fmt as string, thumbnail = "" as string, description = "" as string) item = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") item.title = title item.url = url item.streamFormat = fmt item.HDPosterUrl = thumbnail item.description = description parent.appendChild(item) end sub
' ===== Single Object Helper ===== sub addItemFromObject(parent as object, obj as object) if type(obj) <> "roAssociativeArray" then return
item = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") item.title = getString(obj, "title", "Untitled") item.url = getString(obj, "url", "") item.streamFormat = getString(obj, "streamFormat", "mp4") item.HDPosterUrl = getString(obj, "thumbnail", "") item.description = getString(obj, "description", "") parent.appendChild(item) end sub
' ===== Array or JSON String Helper ===== sub addItems(parent as object, itemsInput as dynamic) itemList = invalid
if type(itemsInput) = "roArray" itemList = itemsInput else if type(itemsInput) = "roString" or type(itemsInput) = "String" itemList = ParseJson(itemsInput) end if
if itemList <> invalid and type(itemList) = "roArray" for each obj in itemList addItemFromObject(parent, obj) end for end if end sub
' ===== Safe property lookup with default string value ===== function getString(obj as object, key as string, defaultVal = "" as string) as string if obj.doesExist(key) and obj[key] <> invalid return obj[key].toStr() end if return defaultVal end function
sub onItemSelected(event as object) position = event.getData() if type(position) = "roArray" index = position[0] * m.contentGrid.numColumns + position[1] else index = position end if
selectedItem = m.contentGrid.content.getChild(index) if selectedItem = invalid then return
videoContent = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") videoContent.url = selectedItem.url videoContent.title = selectedItem.title videoContent.streamFormat = selectedItem.streamFormat videoContent.HttpCertificatesFile = "common:/certs/ca-bundle.crt"
m.listContainer.visible = false m.video.visible = true m.playbackAttemptActive = true showLoadingDialog() m.video.content = videoContent m.video.control = "play" m.video.setFocus(true)
' Start watchdog — fires if video never reaches "playing" within timeout m.loadWatchdog.duration = m.loadTimeoutSeconds m.loadWatchdog.control = "start" end sub
sub onVideoState(event as object) if not m.playbackAttemptActive then return
state = event.getData() if state = "playing" ' Video started successfully — cancel watchdog hideLoadingDialog() m.loadWatchdog.control = "stop" else if state = "finished" m.loadWatchdog.control = "stop" returnToList() else if state = "error" m.loadWatchdog.control = "stop" showErrorDialog(getHttpErrorMessage(m.video.errorCode)) end if end sub
sub onLoadTimeout() if not m.playbackAttemptActive then return
' Watchdog fired — video never started playing in time showErrorDialog("Video failed to load. Please check your connection and try again.") end sub
' Classify errorCode into a user-friendly message. ' HTTP errors are surfaced as -(HTTP status code) by the Video node. function getHttpErrorMessage(errorCode as integer) as string if errorCode = -400 then return "Bad request (400). The video URL may be malformed." if errorCode = -401 then return "Unauthorized (401). Login may be required to watch this video." if errorCode = -403 then return "Access denied (403). You do not have permission to watch this video." if errorCode = -404 then return "Video not found (404). The video may have been removed." if errorCode = -408 then return "Request timed out (408). Please check your connection and try again." if errorCode = -429 then return "Too many requests (429). Please wait a moment and try again." if errorCode >= -599 and errorCode <= -500 return "Server error (" + (-errorCode).toStr() + "). Please try again later." end if ' Non-HTTP error — fall back to the raw message from the Video node if m.video.errorMsg <> invalid and m.video.errorMsg <> "" return m.video.errorMsg end if return "An unexpected error occurred. Please try again." end function
sub showLoadingDialog() m.loadingDialogActive = true m.top.dialog = m.loadingDialog end sub
sub hideLoadingDialog() if not m.loadingDialogActive then return
m.loadingDialogActive = false m.loadingDialog.close = true end sub
sub onLoadingDialogClosed() if not m.loadingDialogActive then return
' The user dismissed the loading dialog with Back m.loadingDialogActive = false returnToList() end sub
sub showErrorDialog(message as string) if m.errorDialogActive or not m.playbackAttemptActive then return
' Ignore any video-state or watchdog events already queued for this attempt. m.playbackAttemptActive = false m.loadWatchdog.control = "stop"
' Replacing the Scene dialog closes the loading dialog automatically. ' Do not explicitly close it first, or its pending close can dismiss this dialog. m.loadingDialogActive = false m.video.control = "stop" m.video.visible = false m.errorDialog.message = message m.errorDialogActive = true m.errorDialogInputEnabled = false m.top.dialog = m.errorDialog m.errorInputGuard.control = "start" end sub
sub onErrorDialogButton() if not m.errorDialogInputEnabled then return
m.errorDialog.close = true end sub
sub onErrorInputGuardExpired() if m.errorDialogActive m.errorDialogInputEnabled = true end if end sub
sub onErrorDialogClosed() if not m.errorDialogActive then return
m.errorInputGuard.control = "stop" m.errorDialogInputEnabled = false m.errorDialogActive = false returnToList() end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as string, press as boolean) as boolean if not press then return false if key = "back" and m.video.visible returnToList() return true end if return false end function
sub returnToList() m.playbackAttemptActive = false m.loadWatchdog.control = "stop" m.errorInputGuard.control = "stop" m.errorDialogInputEnabled = false m.video.control = "stop" m.video.visible = false hideLoadingDialog() if m.errorDialogActive m.errorDialogActive = false m.errorDialog.close = true end if m.listContainer.visible = true m.contentGrid.setFocus(true) end sub
